sizes.name: Small
sizes.rule: About 10 to 30 minutes of agent work, one commit, usually one page or one file. Low risk, easy to undo.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.rule: A few hours. Touches many pages or adds a tool. A few commits, screenshots to review, a tag per piece.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.rule: Several sessions. Changes how the site is built or what it does. Plan first, your approval before building, staged launch.

agent.title: Run a no-input pass and polish sweep
agent.when: After any batch of changes, or on a schedule.
agent.prompt: Run the no-input-polish-pass skill on the Fixing Friction site. Repo: {R}. Work on a new branch, run node tools/check.mjs before and after, keep only safe and reversible changes, and finish with the report. Do not merge or push.

agent.title: Log what you just did
agent.when: At the end of every piece of work, by the agent.
agent.prompt: Add an entry for the work you just finished to docs/changes-data.json (date, title, size S, M or L, owner, tag, what, why, how it was verified, how to undo it), set any finished suggestion to status done, add any new suggestions you noticed, then run python tools/build_changes_page.py and node tools/check.mjs. Repo: {R}.

agent.title: Apply my status updates
agent.when: After you tick statuses on the page and copy your updates.
agent.prompt: Apply these status updates to docs/changes-data.json, rebuild the page with python tools/build_changes_page.py, and commit: [paste the copied updates]. Repo: {R}.

agent.title: Run the site check
agent.prompt: Run node tools/check.mjs in {R} and report any failure with the page and rule. Fix what is safe, list the rest.

human.title: Pick and bundle changes
steps: Open the next-steps list and filter by size or owner.
Tick the items you want, or press Select all small.
Press Copy combined prompt and paste it into Claude Code in the site folder.
Fill any [brackets] in the prompt first (files, links, choices). Items marked Needs: show what to prepare.

human.title: Review a branch before it goes live
steps: Ask Claude for before and after screenshots of the pages named.
Look at the pages on your phone and your laptop.
Check the changes entry on this page: what changed, how it was checked, how to undo it.
Say merge and push, or say what to change.

human.title: Track your decisions
steps: Use the status menus on suggested changes: Suggested, In progress, Done, Skipped.
Press Copy my status updates and send them to Claude with the Apply my status updates prompt.
Statuses you set are saved in your browser until Claude records them in the data file.

human.title: Launch steps and approvals
steps: Use the launch checklist page for team approval, legal pages, email DNS, GHL, Twilio and the step that opens the site to crawlers.
